summary: RMX Industries, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 reporting an email agreement with an institutional investor to extend the maturity date of a previously issued senior secured convertible note from May 30, 2026 to August 31, 2026. The note, with an original principal amount of $2,020,000 and 15% interest, was issued as part of a $50 million offering in 2025. No new terms, price, premium, or structural changes were disclosed beyond the maturity extension. The filing reflects routine debt management rather than a transformative event. What to watch: potential further extensions or conversion activity.
